name: Bashal'Aran
summary: At Bashal'Aran, Asterion seeks release from the magic binding his ghostly form. He suspects the grells have touched the seal that holds him, and asks travelers to gather their earrings so he can trace its lingering magic.

sections.title: A Centuries-Old Torment
sections.body: Asterion waits among Bashal'Aran's shattered marble, bound there for centuries. The ancient night elf spirit is trapped between life and true death beneath Darkshore's canopy. Arcane craft ties him to the ruined settlement, and he cannot break free alone. Solitude and despair have worn down his mind through all those years.

sections.title: Traces in the Wild
sections.body: Asterion believes an ancient seal hidden in the ruins may hold the key to his release. Though he cannot search the brush and fallen stones himself, the feral grells of Bashal'Aran forage there and steal small baubles. He asks travelers to gather their earrings, hoping the trinkets' lingering magic will lead him to the seal that torments his soul.

aliases: who is the ghost in bashal'aran
faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient night elf ghost bound to the ruins of Bashal'Aran in Darkshore. For centuries, a mystical seal has held him in torment, and he longs to be free of his spectral state.

faq.q: Why does Asterion want grell earrings?
faq.answer: Asterion wants grell earrings because he believes the creatures have touched the seal binding him. Their earrings may carry traces of its magic and help him find it.
Bashal'Aran is an ancient night elf ruin on Darkshore's forested coast, dating to before the Great Sundering. Wild grells, satyrs, and spectral remnants of its fallen inhabitants now roam there.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the earrings?
aliases: did the grells have the seal
faq.answer: After travelers gather the earrings, Asterion examines them. He senses that the grells have brushed against the seal in what he considers recent times, though they do not carry it, and he can narrow down its location in the ruins.
An ancient magical seal bound Asterion to Bashal'Aran centuries ago. It anchors his spirit to the ruins and keeps him from finding peaceful rest.
Grells are small, malicious woodland creatures native to Kalimdor's forests. They have sharp claws, a taste for trinkets, and a habit of infesting old ruins and attacking travelers.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you may see Asterion as a reminder of the ancient civilization lost in the Sundering, and of souls left bound in ruin for millennia.
As a mage, you may recognize Asterion's use of enchanted trinkets to trace lingering magic as an ancient Highborne practice of arcane divination.
As an Alliance traveler, you help pacify Darkshore's treacherous northern reaches by clearing the chaotic grells around Bashal'Aran.
